        title = self.pj.get("title") or self.slug
        first_main = next(s for s in segs if not s["id"].startswith("cold"))
        if SET.template_ok(S, "title_card"):                 # [settings] motion.title_card
            overlays.append({"type": "motion", "template": "title_card",
                             "vars": {"title": title.upper()[:40], "subtitle": self.brand.get("channel_name", "")},
                             "seg": first_main["id"], "rel": 1.9 if lead else 0.4})
            self.caption_hides.append({"seg": first_main["id"], "rel": 1.9 if lead else 0.4, "dur": 2.5})  # title owns the frame
        if duration > 45 and SET.template_ok(S, "crodie_subscribe"):   # [settings] motion.subscribe_cta                                # subscribe CTA in a CALM stretch - never on a joke or a panic
            t, calm = 0.0, None
            for s in segs:
                d = seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i))
                strong = any(s["type"] == "source" and s["in"] <= b["t"] < s["out"] and b["score"] >= 3 for b in beats)
                if (s["type"] == "source" and not s["id"].startswith("cold") and s.get("mode") == self.base_mode
                        and not strong and d >= 3.5 and 0.35 * duration <= t <= 0.75 * duration):
                    calm = s
                    break
                t += d
            if calm:
                overlays.append({"type": "motion", "template": "crodie_subscribe",     # mascot CTA
                                 "vars": {},
                                 "seg": calm["id"], "rel": 0.3})
                self.caption_hides.append({"seg": calm["id"], "rel": 0.3, "dur": 3.5})
        # (mode stingers are a manual tool now - automatic colour flashes were distracting)

        edl = {"version": 1, "project": self.slug, "title": title, "mode": self.base_mode,
               "generator": "autoplan", "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays, "text": texts,
               "audio": {"sfx": sfx, "bleeps": [], "music": []},
               "captions": {"enabled": S["captions"]["enabled"],                     # [settings]
                            "emphasis_words": sorted(emphasis)[:20] if S["captions"]["emphasis"] else [],
                            "hide": self.caption_hides}}
        wm = self.brand.get("watermark", {})
        if wm.get("enabled") and S["brand"]["watermark"]:                       # [settings]
            edl["watermark"] = {"text": wm.get("text", ""), "opacity": wm.get("opacity", 0.55),
                                **({"image": wm["image"]} if wm.get("image") else {})}
        if Ca["engage_zooms"]:                                                    # [settings]
            engage(edl, self.words, self.modes)
        if S["audio"]["music"]:
            self.music(edl)
        for x in edl["audio"]["sfx"]:
            x.pop("_beat", None)
        if use_cin and Me["cutaways"]:                      # [autopilot] Cinematic Director places rendered+QA'd shots
            fn = cinematic_splice()
            try:
                edl = fn(edl, self.slug) or edl
            except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001 - never lose the edit over b-roll
                print(f"[autoplan] cinematic.splice_into_edl failed: {ex}", flush=True)
        return edl

    STICKER_MOMENTS = {"death", "shock", "jumpscare", "panic", "victory", "loot", "fail", "rage", "confusion",
                       "explosion", "irony", "flex"}

    def sticker_beat(self, b: dict, s: dict, overlays: list, busy: bool, duration: float) -> None:
        """The channel mascot reacts: a Crodie emote pops in a corner on a big beat (crying on a death, screaming
        on a jumpscare, heart eyes on loot). Sparse: strong beats only, >=25 s apart, ~1 per 40 s, never on a beat
        that already got a meme / green screen / game-UI graphic. A death screen is the payoff: it always gets the
        crying reaction, and the panic right before it stays clean so the two don't stack."""
        if busy or b["score"] < 4 or b["moment"] not in self.STICKER_MOMENTS \
                or not SET.template_ok(self.S, "sticker_pop"):     # [settings] brand.stickers / templates
            return
        deaths = [d["t"] for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", [])]
        if not b.get("death_screen") and any(0 < d - b["t"] < 15 for d in deaths):
            return                                       # leave the build-up clean for the death payoff
        ts = self.mg_used.setdefault("sticker_pop", [])
        if not b.get("death_screen") and (len(ts) >= max(1, min(5, int(duration / 40)))
                                          or any(abs(b["t"] - t) < 25 for t in ts)):
            return
        q = A.Query(moments=[b["moment"]], roles=["emotes"], categories=["brand_sticker"], project=self.slug,
                    exclude=self.used, limit=8, seed=self.rng.randint(0, 10 ** 6))
        res = [a for a in A.find(q) if b["moment"] in (a.get("moments") or [])]
        made_for = [a for a in res if a["moments"][0] == b["moment"]]   # emotes drawn FOR this moment first
        pool = (made_for or res)[:3]
        if not pool:
            return
        a = pool[0] if len(pool) == 1 or self.rng.random() < 0.6 else self.rng.choice(pool)
        self.used.append(a["id"])
        ts.append(b["t"])
        badge = a["id"].startswith("crodie.badge_")
        at = b["t"] + 0.6 if b.get("death_screen") else b["end"] + 0.1
        overlays.append({"type": "motion", "template": "sticker_pop", "seg": s["id"], "src_at": round(at, 3),
                         "vars": {"image": a["path"],                     # studio-relative (brand/crodie/...)
                                  "position": "center" if badge else ("top-right" if len(ts) % 2 else "top-left"),
                                  "style": "stamp" if badge else "pop"},
                         **({"dur": 2.2} if b.get("death_screen") else {})})

    def motion_beat(self, b: dict, s: dict, overlays: list) -> bool:
        """Game-UI motion graphics for beats that literally match them. Sparing by design: each template has a
        per-video cap and a minimum gap, and only fires on a clear spoken trigger (creator: no overuse)."""
        kw = (b.get("phrase") or b.get("keyword") or "").lower()
        used = self.mg_used
        def ok(name, cap, gap):
            if not SET.template_ok(self.S, name):           # [settings] per-template switches
                return False
            ts = used.setdefault(name, [])
            return len(ts) < cap and all(abs(b["t"] - t) > gap for t in ts)
        ov = None
        if b["moment"] == "loot" and b["score"] >= 4 and ok("advancement_toast", 2, 40):
            ov = {"template": "advancement_toast", "vars": {"title": kw.title().rstrip("!") + "!", "kind": "task"}}
        elif b["moment"] == "location" and ok("location_tag", 2, 60):
            ov = {"template": "location_tag",
                  "vars": {"text": kw.upper(), "sub": "", "icon": LOCATION_ICON.get(kw, "compass")}}
        elif b["moment"] == "boss" and ok("boss_bar", 1, 0):
            ov = {"template": "boss_bar", "vars": {"name": kw.title().replace("The ", ""),
                                                    "color": BOSS_COLOR.get(kw, "pink")}}
        if not ov:
            return False
        used[ov["template"]].append(b["t"])
        overlays.append({"type": "motion", **ov, "seg": s["id"], "src_at": round(b["end"] + 0.05, 3)})
        return True

    def _sfx_for(self, moments, roles, seg_id, t, align):
        if not self.S["audio"]["sfx"]:                       # [settings]
            return None
        a = self.pick(moments, roles, categories=["sfx_meme", "sfx_ui", "sfx_mlg"], max_duration=4)
        return {"asset": a["id"], "seg": seg_id, "src_at": round(t, 3), "align": align} if a else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ music per mode run
    FAMILY = {"funny": "funny", "happy": "funny", "pov": "funny", "broll": "funny", "narration": "narration",
              "exciting": "exciting", "angry": "exciting", "scary": "scary", "sad": "sad", "flashback": "sad",
              "serious": "serious"}

    def music(self, edl: dict) -> None:
        """A bed per *music family* run. Beds only change for runs >= 12 s (mood blips don't swap songs);
        a short sad/death ending gets silence so the sting lands."""
        t = 0.0
        runs: list[list] = []                                # [family, start, end]
        for s in edl["segments"]:
            d = seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i))
            if s["id"].startswith("cold"):
                t += d
                continue
            f = self.FAMILY.get(s.get("mode") or edl["mode"], "funny") if s["type"] != "cutaway" \
                else (runs[-1][0] if runs else "funny")
            if runs and runs[-1][0] == f:
                runs[-1][2] = t + d
            else:
                runs.append([f, t, t + d])
            t += d
        if runs and runs[-1][0] == "sad" and runs[-1][2] - runs[-1][1] < 12:
            runs.pop()
        merged: list[list] = []
        for r in runs:
            if merged and (r[2] - r[1] < 12 or merged[-1][0] == r[0]):
                merged[-1][2] = r[2]
            else:
                merged.append(r)
        for m, a, z in merged:
            cfg = self.modes.get(m, {}).get("music", {})
            lo, hi = cfg.get("energy", [1, 5])
            pick = self.pick(cfg.get("moments", ["exploring"]), ["music_bed"], categories=["music"], max_risk="medium",
                             min_energy=lo, max_energy=hi, min_duration=30)
            if pick:
                edl["audio"]["music"].append({"asset": pick["id"], "at": round(a, 3), "until": round(z, 3),
                                              "in": round(min(20.0, (pick["duration_s"] or 60) * 0.1), 1),
                                              "fade_in": 0.8, "fade_out": 1.0, "duck": True, "_mode": m})
        for x in edl["audio"]["music"]:
            x.pop("_mode", None)

"""One-click creative pass: transcript + signals + project context -> a complete edit.json.

    mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny] [--no-cold-open] [--seed 1]
    mcs engage <slug>          # only the engagement pass (auto zooms) on an existing edit

This is the deterministic baseline so "add footage + mic -> video" works with no human or LLM in the
loop. A Claude pass (/mc-edit) on top is still better at context and jokes; it can start from this.

Pipeline:
  1. segments   keep speech (+ action peaks), drop dead air; "fast forward" gaps become 4x montages
  2. beats      keyword lexicon + voice peaks + death screens -> taxonomy moments with a score
  3. modes      each segment gets a mood from its beats (sad on deaths, scary on panic, ...)
  4. cold open  strongest late beat is teased first, then "N MINUTES EARLIER"
  5. treatments per beat: SFX / zoom / shake / freeze / text / meme cutaway / green screen, within budgets
  6. engage     guarantee a visual change every mode.zoom.every_s seconds (punch-ins, jump-cut reframes)
  7. music      one bed per run of the same mode; captions emphasis; watermark; outro CTA
Every event is anchored to its segment ({"seg": id, ...}) so shorts can be cut from the edit later.
"""

import random
import re

"""Deterministic first pass: transcript + signals -> edit.json with dead air removed.

    mcs scaffold ep01 [--max-gap 0.6] [--pad 0.15] [--keep-action 1.2] [--music <asset-id>]

Keeps every spoken word (padded), keeps game/voice peaks with some context, cuts gaps longer than
--max-gap. The planner then layers zooms, SFX, memes, captions emphasis etc. on top of this.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from . import assets as A
from .paths import project_dir


def keep_ranges(words: list[dict], events: list[dict], dur: float, pad: float, max_gap: float,
                keep_action: float, min_len: float = 0.8) -> list[list[float]]:
    rs = [[max(0, w["start"] - pad), min(dur, w["end"] + pad + 0.2)] for w in words]   # ASR ends early: generous tail
    rs += [[max(0, e["t"] - keep_action), min(dur, e["t"] + keep_action)] for e in events]
    rs.sort()
    merged: list[list[float]] = []
    for a, b in rs:
        if merged and a - merged[-1][1] <= max_gap:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], b)
        else:
            merged.append([a, b])
    return [[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in merged if b - a >= min_len]


def scaffold(slug: str, max_gap: float = 0.6, pad: float = 0.18, keep_action: float = 1.2,
             music: str | None = None, force: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    dest = proj / "edit.json"
    if dest.exists() and not force:
        raise SystemExit("edit.json exists - pass --force to overwrite (it will be backed up)")
    if dest.exists():
        dest.replace(proj / "edit.backup.json")
    pj = json.loads((proj / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    tr_p, sig_p = proj / "work" / "transcript.json", proj / "work" / "signals.json"
    words = []
    if tr_p.exists():
        tr = json.loads(tr_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        words = [w for s in tr["segments"] for w in s["words"]]
    sig = json.loads(sig_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if sig_p.exists() else {}
    events = sig.get("voice_peaks", []) + sig.get("game_peaks", [])
    dur = pj["duration_s"]
    from .settings import load as load_settings            # [settings] editing.dead_air_removal / audio.music
    S = load_settings(slug)
    ranges = keep_ranges(words, events, dur, pad, max_gap, keep_action) \
        if (words or events) and S["editing"]["dead_air_removal"] else [[0, dur]]
    segs = [{"id": f"s{i + 1:03d}", "type": "source", "in": a, "out": b} for i, (a, b) in enumerate(ranges)]
    kept = sum(b - a for a, b in ranges)

    if not music and S["audio"]["music"]:
        pick = A.find(A.Query(categories=["music"], moments=["exploring", "building"], roles=["music_bed"],
                              max_risk="low", max_energy=3, project=slug, limit=1))
        music = pick[0]["id"] if pick else None
    edl = {
        "version": 1,
        "project": slug,
        "title": pj.get("title", slug),
        "segments": segs,
        "overlays": [],
        "text": [],
        "audio": {"sfx": [], "bleeps": [],
                  "music": [{"asset": music, "at": 0, "fade_in": 1.0, "fade_out": 2.0, "duck": True}] if music else []},
        "captions": {"enabled": S["captions"]["enabled"], "emphasis_words": [], "hide": []},
    }
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[scaffold] {len(segs)} segments, kept {kept:.0f}s of {dur:.0f}s ({100 * kept / max(dur, 1):.0f}%), "
          f"music={music} -> edit.json")

Run from studio/:  uv run python projects/rd-full/build_edit.py [--budget 1380]

  * WINDOWS below = hand-picked stretches of the story (part, start, end, priority, note).  Each window is tightened with the

  * MONT = block-breaking / mob-killing montages: instead of watching it, we keep only a 0.4 s fragment around every loud game
    sound (the actual block break) so it plays as a rapid-fire "tink tink tink" montage.

def load():
    tr = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "transcript.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    words = [x for s in tr["segments"] for x in s.get("words", [])]
    sig = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return words, sig


def fragments(sig, a, b, secs, pre=0.16, post=0.24):
    """Fragments around loud game sounds so the montage shows only the break/place moment."""
    pk = sorted([p for p in sig.get("game_peaks", []) if a <= p["t"] < b], key=lambda p: p["t"])
    n = max(3, int(secs / (pre + post)))
    # keep peaks >= 0.9 s apart, strongest first, until n
    chosen: list[float] = []
    for p in sorted(pk, key=lambda p: -p.get("above_baseline_db", 0)):
        if all(abs(p["t"] - c) >= 0.9 for c in chosen):
            chosen.append(p["t"])
        if len(chosen) >= n:
            break
    if len(chosen) < n:                                       # too few peaks: fill with even samples
        k = n - len(chosen)
        for i in range(k):
            t = a + (b - a) * (i + 0.5) / k
            if all(abs(t - c) >= 0.6 for c in chosen):
                chosen.append(t)
    return [[round(max(a, t - pre), 3), round(min(b, t + post), 3)] for t in sorted(chosen)]


class RDPlanner(AP.Planner):
    def __init__(self, *a, **k):
        super().__init__(*a, **k)
        self.sel: list[dict] = []          # chosen windows [{a,b,...}]
        self.explicit_mode: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.cold_segs: list[dict] = []

    def segments(self, beats):
        words, sig = self.words, self.sig
        dur = TOTAL
        segs = []
        for win in self.sel:
            a, b = win["a"], win["b"]
            if win.get("mont"):
                for fa, fb in fragments(sig, a, b, win["mont"]):
                    segs.append({"in": fa, "out": fb, "montage": True, "win": win["id"], "exact": True, **win["extra"]})
                continue
            ww = [x for x in words if a - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= b + 0.3]
            for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], dur, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6):
                segs.append({"in": ra, "out": rb, "win": win["id"], **{k: v for k, v in win["extra"].items() if k != "cinematic"}})
        final = []
        for k, s in enumerate(segs):
            s["id"] = f"s{k + 1:03d}"
            s["type"] = "source"
            if "mode" in s:
                self.explicit_mode[s["id"]] = s.pop("mode")
            s.pop("act", None)
            final.append(s)
        return final

    def assign_modes(self, segs, beats):
        super().assign_modes(segs, beats)
        for s in segs:
            if s["id"] in self.explicit_mode:
                s["mode"] = self.explicit_mode[s["id"]]
            elif s.get("montage"):
                s["mode"] = "exciting"


def window_dur(win, sig, words):
    if win.get("mont"):
        return len(fragments(sig, win["a"], win["b"], win["mont"])) * 0.4
    ww = [x for x in words if win["a"] - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= win["b"] + 0.3]
    return sum(rb - ra for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], TOTAL, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1380.0, help="target length in seconds (default 23 min)")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    planner = RDPlanner("rd-full", cold_open=False)
    words, sig = planner.words, planner.sig

    wins = []
    for i, (part, a, b, pri, note, kw) in enumerate(W):
        win = {"id": f"w{i:03d}", "part": part, "a": T(part, a), "b": T(part, b), "pri": pri, "note": note,
               "mont": kw.get("mont"), "extra": {k: v for k, v in kw.items() if k not in ("mont", "cinematic")},
               "cinematic": kw.get("cinematic")}
        win["dur"] = window_dur(win, sig, words)
        wins.append(win)
    cold = sum(T(p, b) - T(p, a) for p, a, b in COLD)
    fixed = cold + 14.0        # cold open + title + time card + end card
    total = lambda ws: fixed + sum(x["dur"] for x in ws)  # noqa: E731
    keep = list(wins)
    print(f"all windows: {total(keep):.0f}s  budget {args.budget:.0f}s")
    for pri in (3, 2):
        if total(keep) <= args.budget:
            break
        # drop lowest-value priority class, longest first, until it fits
        cand = sorted([x for x in keep if x["pri"] == pri], key=lambda x: -x["dur"])
        for x in cand:
            if total(keep) <= args.budget:
                break
            keep.remove(x)
    print(f"kept {len(keep)}/{len(wins)} windows -> {total(keep):.0f}s ({total(keep) / 60:.1f} min)")
    planner.sel = keep
    edl = planner.plan()
    # --- own cold open
    cold_segs = []
    for i, (p, a, b) in enumerate(COLD, 1):
        cold_segs.append({"id": f"cold-{i}", "type": "source", "in": round(T(p, a), 3), "out": round(T(p, b), 3),
                          "zoom": [{"src_at": round(T(p, a) + 0.4, 3), "to": 1.25, "in": 0.1, "hold": 1.5, "out": 0.2}]})
    edl["segments"] = cold_segs + edl["segments"]
    edl["generator"] = "rd-full custom"          # hand-built: autoplan / auto must not overwrite
    edl["max_rating"] = "mild"
    # --- bleeps on strong swear words in kept footage
    kept = [(s["in"], s["out"]) for s in edl["segments"] if s["type"] == "source"]
    bleeps = []
    for x in words:
        if SWEARS.search(re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", x["word"].lower())) and any(a - 0.05 <= x["start"] <= b for a, b in kept):
            bleeps.append({"src_at": round(x["start"] - 0.03, 3), "dur": round(max(0.35, x["end"] - x["start"] + 0.12), 3)})
    edl["audio"]["bleeps"] = bleeps
    (HERE / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (HERE / "plan_windows.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        [{k: v for k, v in x.items() if k != "extra"} for x in keep], indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    dur = sum(seg_duration(s) for s in edl["segments"])
    print(f"edit.json: {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {dur:.0f}s ({dur / 60:.1f} min), {len(bleeps)} bleeps, "
          f"{len(edl['audio']['sfx'])} sfx, {len(edl['overlays'])} overlays")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    tr = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "transcript.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    words = [x for s in tr["segments"] for x in s.get("words", [])]
    sig = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return words, sig


def fragments(sig, a, b, secs, pre=0.16, post=0.24):
    """Fragments around loud game sounds so the montage shows only the break/place moment."""
    pk = sorted([p for p in sig.get("game_peaks", []) if a <= p["t"] < b], key=lambda p: p["t"])
    n = max(3, int(secs / (pre + post)))
    # keep peaks >= 0.9 s apart, strongest first, until n
    chosen: list[float] = []
    for p in sorted(pk, key=lambda p: -p.get("above_baseline_db", 0)):
        if all(abs(p["t"] - c) >= 0.9 for c in chosen):
            chosen.append(p["t"])
        if len(chosen) >= n:
            break
    if len(chosen) < n:                                       # too few peaks: fill with even samples
        k = n - len(chosen)
        for i in range(k):
            t = a + (b - a) * (i + 0.5) / k
            if all(abs(t - c) >= 0.6 for c in chosen):
                chosen.append(t)
    return [[round(max(a, t - pre), 3), round(min(b, t + post), 3)] for t in sorted(chosen)]


class RDPlanner(AP.Planner):
    def __init__(self, *a, **k):
        super().__init__(*a, **k)
        self.sel: list[dict] = []          # chosen windows [{a,b,...}]
        self.explicit_mode: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.cold_segs: list[dict] = []

    def segments(self, beats):
        words, sig = self.words, self.sig
        dur = TOTAL
        segs = []
        for win in self.sel:
            a, b = win["a"], win["b"]
            if win.get("mont"):
                for fa, fb in fragments(sig, a, b, win["mont"]):
                    segs.append({"in": fa, "out": fb, "montage": True, "win": win["id"], "exact": True, **win["extra"]})
                continue
            ww = [x for x in words if a - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= b + 0.3]
            for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], dur, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6):
                segs.append({"in": ra, "out": rb, "win": win["id"], **{k: v for k, v in win["extra"].items() if k != "cinematic"}})
        final = []
        for k, s in enumerate(segs):
            s["id"] = f"s{k + 1:03d}"
            s["type"] = "source"
            if "mode" in s:
                self.explicit_mode[s["id"]] = s.pop("mode")
            s.pop("act", None)
            final.append(s)
        return final

    def assign_modes(self, segs, beats):
        super().assign_modes(segs, beats)
        for s in segs:
            if s["id"] in self.explicit_mode:
                s["mode"] = self.explicit_mode[s["id"]]
            elif s.get("montage"):
                s["mode"] = "exciting"


def window_dur(win, sig, words):
    if win.get("mont"):
        return len(fragments(sig, win["a"], win["b"], win["mont"])) * 0.4
    ww = [x for x in words if win["a"] - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= win["b"] + 0.3]
    return sum(rb - ra for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], TOTAL, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6))

    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1380.0, help="target length in seconds (default 23 min)")

            ww = [x for x in words if a - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= b + 0.3]
            for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], dur, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6):
                segs.append({"in": ra, "out": rb, "win": win["id"], **{k: v for k, v in win["extra"].items() if k != "cinematic"}})
        final = []
        for k, s in enumerate(segs):
            s["id"] = f"s{k + 1:03d}"
            s["type"] = "source"
            if "mode" in s:
                self.explicit_mode[s["id"]] = s.pop("mode")
            s.pop("act", None)
            final.append(s)
        return final

    def assign_modes(self, segs, beats):
        super().assign_modes(segs, beats)
        for s in segs:
            if s["id"] in self.explicit_mode:
                s["mode"] = self.explicit_mode[s["id"]]
            elif s.get("montage"):
                s["mode"] = "exciting"


def window_dur(win, sig, words):
    if win.get("mont"):
        return len(fragments(sig, win["a"], win["b"], win["mont"])) * 0.4
    ww = [x for x in words if win["a"] - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= win["b"] + 0.3]
    return sum(rb - ra for ra, rb in keep_ranges(ww, [], TOTAL, pad=0.18, max_gap=0.6, keep_action=0, min_len=0.6))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1380.0, help="target length in seconds (default 23 min)")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    planner = RDPlanner("rd-full", cold_open=False)
    words, sig = planner.words, planner.sig

    wins = []
    for i, (part, a, b, pri, note, kw) in enumerate(W):
        win = {"id": f"w{i:03d}", "part": part, "a": T(part, a), "b": T(part, b), "pri": pri, "note": note,
               "mont": kw.get("mont"), "extra": {k: v for k, v in kw.items() if k not in ("mont", "cinematic")},
               "cinematic": kw.get("cinematic")}
        win["dur"] = window_dur(win, sig, words)
        wins.append(win)
    cold = sum(T(p, b) - T(p, a) for p, a, b in COLD)
    fixed = cold + 14.0        # cold open + title + time card + end card
    total = lambda ws: fixed + sum(x["dur"] for x in ws)  # noqa: E731
    keep = list(wins)
    print(f"all windows: {total(keep):.0f}s  budget {args.budget:.0f}s")
    for pri in (3, 2):
        if total(keep) <= args.budget:
            break
        # drop lowest-value priority class, longest first, until it fits
        cand = sorted([x for x in keep if x["pri"] == pri], key=lambda x: -x["dur"])
        for x in cand:
            if total(keep) <= args.budget:
                break
            keep.remove(x)
    print(f"kept {len(keep)}/{len(wins)} windows -> {total(keep):.0f}s ({total(keep) / 60:.1f} min)")
    planner.sel = keep
    edl = planner.plan()
    # --- own cold open
    cold_segs = []
    for i, (p, a, b) in enumerate(COLD, 1):
        cold_segs.append({"id": f"cold-{i}", "type": "source", "in": round(T(p, a), 3), "out": round(T(p, b), 3),
                          "zoom": [{"src_at": round(T(p, a) + 0.4, 3), "to": 1.25, "in": 0.1, "hold": 1.5, "out": 0.2}]})
    edl["segments"] = cold_segs + edl["segments"]
    edl["generator"] = "rd-full custom"          # hand-built: autoplan / auto must not overwrite
    edl["max_rating"] = "mild"
    # --- bleeps on strong swear words in kept footage
    kept = [(s["in"], s["out"]) for s in edl["segments"] if s["type"] == "source"]
    bleeps = []
    for x in words:
        if SWEARS.search(re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", x["word"].lower())) and any(a - 0.05 <= x["start"] <= b for a, b in kept):
            bleeps.append({"src_at": round(x["start"] - 0.03, 3), "dur": round(max(0.35, x["end"] - x["start"] + 0.12), 3)})
    edl["audio"]["bleeps"] = bleeps
    (HERE / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (HERE / "plan_windows.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        [{k: v for k, v in x.items() if k != "extra"} for x in keep], indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    dur = sum(seg_duration(s) for s in edl["segments"])
    print(f"edit.json: {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {dur:.0f}s ({dur / 60:.1f} min), {len(bleeps)} bleeps, "
          f"{len(edl['audio']['sfx'])} sfx, {len(edl['overlays'])} overlays")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Behaviour notes:

    (1, "52:26.0", "meme_video.238-the-kid-said-jesus-christ"),     # creeper out of thin air

    (3, "79:40.0", "meme_video.84-dr-evil-crying"),                 # I give up
]


def insert_memes(edl: dict) -> list:
    from mcstudio import assets as A
    segs = edl["segments"]
    miss = []
    for part, ts, aid in MEMES:
        t = T(part, ts)
        k = next((i for i, s in enumerate(segs) if s["type"] == "source" and not s["id"].startswith("cold")
                  and s["in"] - 0.01 <= t <= s["out"] + 0.01), None)
        a = A.get(aid)
        if k is None or a is None or k == len(segs) - 1:
            miss.append((aid, t))
            continue
        lo = a.get("use_in") or 0.0
        hi = a.get("use_out") or a["duration_s"]
        if hi - lo > 3.2:
            hi = lo + 3.2
        segs.insert(k + 1, {"id": f"meme-{aid[-12:]}-{k}", "type": "cutaway", "asset": aid, "in": round(lo, 2), "out": round(hi, 2)})
    return miss
PYEOF

cd "C:/Users/edmem/OneDrive/Desktop/Minecraft Channel/studio/projects/rd-full/work"; cat > cmd_scan.py <<'EOF'
import re, json
times=[float(x) for x in open('kf_times.txt')]
rows=[]
for l in open('ocr_all.txt',encoding='utf-8-sig'):
    if '\t' not in l: continue
    i,t=l.rstrip('\n').split('\t',1)
    try: i=int(i)
    except: continue
    rows.append((i,t))
rx=re.compile(r"game ?mode|gaaemode|gamenode|gameuode|creative|survival|spectator|set o[uw]n|teleport|/[a-z]{3,}|command|cheats|randoa?m?drops|rando&ops|chaos reset|gamerule|unknown or|giv(e|en) |you now|mode to",re.I)
hits=[(times[i-1],t) for i,t in rows if rx.search(t)]
ivs=[]
for ts,t in hits:
    if ivs and ts-ivs[-1][1]<=10: ivs[-1][1]=ts; ivs[-1][2].append(t)
    else: ivs.append([ts,ts,[t]])
out=[]
for a,b,ts in ivs:
    # most informative sample
    s=max(ts,key=lambda x:len(re.findall(rx,x)))
    out.append({"a":round(a,1),"b":round(b,1),"n":len(ts),"sample":s[:160]})
    print(f"{a:8.1f}-{b:8.1f} ({int(a//60)}:{a%60:04.1f}) n={len(ts)}  {s[:140]}")
json.dump(out,open('cmd_intervals.json','w'),indent=1)
EOF
uv run python cmd_scan.py | head -120

tot=sum(b-a for a,b in bad)
print(len(bad),"bad intervals,",round(tot),"s of",round(times[-1]))
# per part totals
for p,(lo,hi) in {1:(0,3922),2:(3922,8702.9),3:(8702.9,13510)}.items():
    s=sum(max(0,min(b,hi)-max(a,lo)) for a,b in bad); print("part",p,round(s),"of",round(hi-lo))
EOF

"""rd-full v2 builder: ONE video from Random Drops parts 1-3 (combined source).

Run from studio/:  uv run python projects/rd-full/build_v2.py [--budget 1420]

What changed from v1 (creator feedback):
  * no looks / grades / brighten filters, a single mode ("funny") everywhere
  * every kept stretch is checked against work/flags.json (per-keyframe scan of the footage):
        cmd/menu/nohud  = chat commands, creative mode, F3 screen, pause menu  -> DROPPED (never shown)
        chat visible but survival HUD   -> kept but punched in so the chat is out of frame
        inventory screens               -> punched in on the inventory (never a tiny GUI in a dark room)
  * the real final take of the intro (retakes are cut), longer word tails so speech is never clipped
  * montage fragments come only from clean survival footage, game+mic audio muted, music + block-hit SFX instead
  * only a few relevant graphics (rd_manual2), explicit music beds per section, Flashback cinematic shots (shots.json)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import bisect
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from mcstudio import assets as A  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio import autoplan as AP  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio.edl import seg_duration  # noqa: E402
import rd_story2 as ST  # noqa: E402
from rd_manual2 import T, post_layers  # noqa: E402

TOTAL = 13510.804
PAD_LEAD, PAD_TAIL, MERGE_GAP = 0.30, 0.55, 0.80          # speech padding: generous tail so words are never cut


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ footage flags
class Flags:
    def __init__(self):
        fl = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "flags.json").read_text())
        hr = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "hearts.json").read_text())
        self.t = fl["t"]
        self.f = list(fl["flag"])
        for k, (fg, red) in enumerate(zip(self.f, hr["red"])):
            if fg == "cmd" and red >= 8:
                self.f[k] = "cmdz"                         # chat visible but survival HUD present -> crop it out

    def span(self, a, b):
        i = bisect.bisect_left(self.t, a - 0.7)
        j = bisect.bisect_right(self.t, b + 0.4)
        return self.f[i:max(i + 1, j)]

    def classify(self, a, b):
        s = self.span(a, b)
        n = max(1, len(s))
        c = {k: sum(1 for x in s if x == k) for k in ("cmd", "menu", "nohud", "cmdz", "gui", "ok", "death")}
        bad = c["cmd"] + c["menu"] + c["nohud"]
        return c, bad, n

    def ok_at(self, t):
        i = bisect.bisect_left(self.t, t)
        i = min(max(i, 0), len(self.f) - 1)
        return self.f[i] in ("ok", "death")


FL = Flags()


def load():
    tr = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "transcript.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    words = [x for s in tr["segments"] for x in s.get("words", [])]
    sig = json.loads((HERE / "work" / "signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return words, sig


def speech_ranges(words, a, b, skips):
    ww = [x for x in words if a - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= b + 0.35
          and not any(sa <= x["start"] < sb for sa, sb in skips)]
    rs = [[max(0, w["start"] - PAD_LEAD), min(TOTAL, w["end"] + PAD_TAIL)] for w in ww]
    rs.sort()
    out = []
    for r in rs:
        if out and r[0] - out[-1][1] <= MERGE_GAP:
            out[-1][1] = max(out[-1][1], r[1])
        else:
            out.append(r)
    return [(round(x, 3), round(y, 3)) for x, y in out if y - x >= 0.7]


def fragments(sig, a, b, secs, pre=0.18, post=0.30):
    """Fragments around loud game sounds taken ONLY from clean survival footage."""
    pk = [p for p in sig.get("game_peaks", []) if a <= p["t"] < b and FL.ok_at(p["t"]) and FL.ok_at(p["t"] + 0.3)
          and FL.ok_at(p["t"] - 0.3)]
    n = max(3, int(secs / (pre + post)))
    chosen: list[float] = []
    for p in sorted(pk, key=lambda p: -p.get("above_baseline_db", 0)):
        if all(abs(p["t"] - c) >= 1.0 for c in chosen):
            chosen.append(p["t"])
        if len(chosen) >= n:
            break
    if len(chosen) < n:
        goods = [t for t in [a + (b - a) * (i + 0.5) / (n * 2) for i in range(n * 2)] if FL.ok_at(t)]
        for t in goods:
            if len(chosen) >= n:
                break
            if all(abs(t - c) >= 0.8 for c in chosen):
                chosen.append(t)
    return [[round(max(a, t - pre), 3), round(min(b, t + post), 3)] for t in sorted(chosen)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ planner (autoplan's SFX/zoom/shake layers on OUR cut)
class RDPlanner(AP.Planner):
    def __init__(self, *a, **k):
        super().__init__(*a, **k)
        self.wins: list[dict] = []
        self.report: list[str] = []

    def segments(self, beats):
        words, sig = self.words, self.sig
        segs = []
        for w in self.wins:
            ex = w["opts"]
            allow_bad = ex.get("allow_bad", False)
            if w["mont"]:
                for fa, fb in fragments(sig, w["a"], w["b"], w["mont"]):
                    segs.append({"in": fa, "out": fb, "exact": True, "mute_game": True, "mute_mic": True,
                                 "_win": w["id"], "_kind": "mont", "_bed": w["bed"]})
                continue
            rs = speech_ranges(words, w["a"], w["b"], w["skips"])
            kept = dropped = 0.0
            for ra, rb in rs:
                c, bad, n = FL.classify(ra, rb)
                if not allow_bad and (bad >= 2 or bad / n > 0.15):
                    dropped += rb - ra
                    continue
                kind = "norm"
                if not allow_bad and c["cmdz"] / n > 0.15:
                    kind = "chat"
                elif c["gui"] / n >= 0.5 and not w["opts"].get("nozoom"):
                    kind = "gui"
                segs.append({"in": ra, "out": rb, "_win": w["id"], "_kind": kind, "_bed": w["bed"]})
                kept += rb - ra
            self.report.append(f"{w['id']:>5} {w['note'][:44]:<44} kept {kept:5.1f}s  dropped(bad) {dropped:5.1f}s")
        final = []
        for k, s in enumerate(segs):
            s["id"] = f"s{k + 1:03d}"
            s["type"] = "source"
            final.append(s)
        return final

    def assign_modes(self, segs, beats):
        for s in segs:
            s["mode"] = "funny"


def window_len(w, sig, words):
    if w["mont"]:
        return len(fragments(sig, w["a"], w["b"], w["mont"])) * 0.48
    tot = 0.0
    for ra, rb in speech_ranges(words, w["a"], w["b"], w["skips"]):
        c, bad, n = FL.classify(ra, rb)
        if w["opts"].get("allow_bad") or not (bad >= 2 or bad / n > 0.15):
            tot += rb - ra
    return tot


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1440.0)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    planner = RDPlanner("rd-full", cold_open=False)
    words, sig = planner.words, planner.sig

    wins = []
    for i, (part, a, b, pri, note, bed, opts) in enumerate(ST.WINDOWS):
        skips = [(T(part, sa), T(part, sb)) for sa, sb in opts.get("skip", [])]
        w = {"id": f"w{i:03d}", "part": part, "a": T(part, a), "b": T(part, b), "pri": pri, "note": note, "bed": bed,
             "mont": opts.get("mont"), "tag": opts.get("tag"), "opts": opts, "skips": skips}
        w["dur"] = window_len(w, sig, words)
        wins.append(w)
    cold_len = 0.0
    cold_wins = []
    for i, (part, a, b, note) in enumerate(ST.COLD):
        ca, cb = T(part, a), T(part, b)
        cold_wins.append((ca, cb, note))
        cold_len += cb - ca
    fixed = cold_len + 4.0 + 5.5               # cold open + title + end card
    keep = list(wins)
    tot = lambda ws: fixed + sum(x["dur"] for x in ws)  # noqa: E731
    print(f"all windows {tot(keep):.0f}s, budget {args.budget:.0f}s")
    for pri in (3, 2):
        if tot(keep) <= args.budget:
            break
        for x in sorted([x for x in keep if x["pri"] == pri], key=lambda x: -x["dur"]):
            if tot(keep) <= args.budget:
                break
            keep.remove(x)
    print(f"kept {len(keep)}/{len(wins)} windows -> {tot(keep):.0f}s ({tot(keep) / 60:.1f} min)")
    planner.wins = keep
    edl = planner.plan()
    print("\n".join(planner.report))

    # ---- cold open (our own cut of the best hook moments)
    cold = []
    for k, (ca, cb, note) in enumerate(cold_wins, 1):
        # snap the cut to complete words
        ww = [x for x in words if ca - 0.05 <= x["start"] and x["end"] <= cb + 0.3]
        if ww:
            ca, cb = max(0, ww[0]["start"] - PAD_LEAD), min(TOTAL, ww[-1]["end"] + PAD_TAIL)
        cold.append({"id": f"cold-{k}", "type": "source", "in": round(ca, 3), "out": round(cb, 3), "_bed": "epic",
                     "_kind": "cold", "zoom": [{"src_at": round(ca + 0.6, 3), "to": 1.22, "in": 0.15, "hold": 1.4, "out": 0.25}]})
    edl["segments"] = cold + edl["segments"]
    edl["generator"] = "rd-full custom v2"
    edl["max_rating"] = "mild"
    edl["mode"] = "funny"
    edl["look"] = "none"

    # ---- per-kind treatment (zoom into inventory, crop chat out, mute/replace montage audio)
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        k = s.get("_kind")
        if k == "gui":
            s["zoom"] = [{"src_at": s["in"] + 0.05, "to": 1.9, "in": 0.35, "focus": [0.5, 0.47]}]

            merged[-1][2] = r[2]
        elif merged and merged[-1][0] == r[0]:
            merged[-1][2] = r[2]
        else:
            merged.append(r)

    for bed, a, z in merged:

"""Hands-off Flashback export through the `flashback_auto` Fabric mod (studio/tools/flashback_auto).

Safe to import and test without Minecraft: nothing is launched unless ``launch=True`` (or env MCS_FLASHBACK_AUTO_LAUNCH=1).

Flow of :meth:`FlashbackAutoExporter.export` (the exact steps the studio takes):

1. parse + validate the job file (same rules as the mod's JobSpec); refuse when outputs are outside ``out_dir``
2. refuse when another Minecraft/javaw is running (autopilot-style probe, see ``launch_render.running_minecraft``)
3. delete stale ``status.json`` / ``STOP`` from the job folder, write ``ARMED`` (``{"job", "created", "token", "pid"}``) next to the job file
4. build the command (``launch_render.build_plan``: ``-Dflashback_auto.job=<job file>``, ``-Dflashback_auto.token=<token>``,
   ``-Dfabric.addMods=<mod jar>``) and start the game, below-normal priority, stdout to ``game_stdout.log``
5. poll ``status.json`` (state starting|opening|exporting|done|failed, progress, results, errors) until the mod reports a final
   state (then wait for the game to quit), the game exits, no status appears (startup timeout), the status goes stale, a STOP file
   is left unanswered, or the overall timeout expires -> kill the process tree (``taskkill /T /F``)
6. ``finally``: kill the game if it is still alive and remove ``ARMED`` (the mod is inert again)
7. one :class:`Result` per job in the job file (output existence and size are re-checked here)

Per-job interface used by ``mcstudio.cinematic`` (``Exporter.render(job) -> Path | None``) is :meth:`FlashbackAutoExporter.render`:
it writes a one-shot job file for a cinematic job, installs that job's editor state for the replay (the creator's original
``editor_states/<uuid>.json`` is backed up and restored afterwards) and runs :meth:`export`. Use :meth:`render_batch` to export
many cinematic jobs of one replay in one game launch.
"""

JOBS_DIR = STUDIO / "cinematic_jobs"
MC_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", str(Path.home() / "AppData/Roaming"))) / ".minecraft"

ARMED = "ARMED"
STOP = "STOP"
STATUS = "status.json"
FINAL_STATES = ("done", "failed")
CONTAINERS = {"MP4", "MKV", "AVI", "MOV", "PNG_SEQUENCE", "WEBP", "WEBM", "GIF"}
CODECS = {"H264", "H265", "AV1", "VP9", "PRO_RES", "QUICK_TIME", "WEBP", "GIF"}
ARMED_MAX_AGE_S = 600


class FlashbackAutoError(RuntimeError):

class JobFileError(FlashbackAutoError):

@dataclass

# Autopilot

Play, stop OBS, close Minecraft. The finished 1080p60 video, the Shorts and `COPY-PASTE.txt` (title options,
description, tags, hashtags, thumbnail prompts) appear in `Finished\<YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM> <title>\`.

Turn it on: UI > Autopilot > switch (or `uv run mcs autopilot enable`). Off by default.

    uv run mcs autopilot run      # foreground loop (the studio UI runs the same loop in a background thread)
    uv run mcs autopilot once     # process what is pending now, then exit  (--no-wait-game, --watch, --output ...)
    uv run mcs autopilot status

Pipeline per recording (one at a time, BELOW_NORMAL priority): project -> transcribe -> analyze -> scaffold ->
autoplan -> **cinematic shots** -> render final -> Shorts -> publish.generate (heuristic, no LLM) -> copy to Finished.
The project is marked "rendered" (Publishing board: Awaiting upload).

Audio tracks: 3+ streams = #2 desktop/game, #3 mic, #1 full mix (ignored); 2 streams = #1 treated as the mix;
1 stream = single mixed track. Mic and game are read from the same file via audio stream indexes.

Rules: originals are never touched; no uploads/network; waits while Minecraft runs or OBS records
(`autopilot.wait_for_game`); a file must be stable 30 s, older than 30 s and readable by ffprobe; recordings shorter
than `min_length_s` and files older than `max_age_h` are ignored; failures are recorded and the loop continues.
State: `studio/autopilot_state.json`; worker logs: `studio/autopilot_logs/`.

## Start at Windows login (optional, not created for you)

Win+R, `shell:startup`, new shortcut with target
`cmd /c "cd /d C:\Users\edmem\OneDrive\Desktop\Minecraft Channel\studio && uv run mcs autopilot run"` (run minimized).
A lock file (PID + heartbeat) keeps only one loop active even if the studio is open too.

## B-roll hook

At plan time, if `mcstudio/cinematic.py` exposes `splice_into_edl(edl, slug)` and `projects/<slug>/broll/shots.json`
exists, that places the shots. Otherwise `autoplan.place_broll` places 2-5 muted 1.5-3 s clips from
`projects/<slug>/broll/*.mp4` (or `Stock Library/Minecraft B-Roll/auto/<session>/`) between segments: an establishing
shot, after loot/death/victory beats, in long calm stretches. No clips = no-op.

## Cinematic shots step  [autopilot-cinematic]

What the creator sees: after the session, **Minecraft opens by itself for a minute or two** (about 90 s for one tiny shot,
2-3 min for two 1080p shots), renders the replay shots and closes again. The Autopilot page says "Rendering cinematic
shots... Minecraft will open for a minute or two: please leave the PC alone" while it runs. Then the video (with the shots)
and the Shorts finish as usual.

Step order inside the worker (`autopilot.cinematic_step`, run record in `work/cinematic_step.json`):

1. `find_replay` (Flashback replay overlapping the recording in wall-clock time) -> none: **skipped, "no replay"**.
2. `plan_shots` on the planned `edit.json` (output time), sync by motion cross-correlation. Sync confidence below
   `cinematic.sync_min_confidence`, or a timestamps-only sync that the video motion did not confirm: **skipped**.
   Nothing is written to `broll/shots.json` for a skipped plan.
3. Wait (up to `autopilot.cinematic_wait_min`, 10) while Minecraft/TLauncher is running or OBS is recording; then give up
   and finish the video without shots. The game is never launched while another one is alive.
4. `queue_jobs` -> `render_queue` with **`FlashbackAutoExporter(launch=True)`** (always the real exporter; the
   `cinematic.exporter` setting is ignored here) -> QA each clip. Watchdog `autopilot.cinematic_timeout_min` (20): on
   timeout the game process tree is killed.
5. `splice` the rendered, QA-passed, real-exporter shots into `edit.json` (backup `edit.v_precinematic.json`), then render
   and Shorts. The Shorts derive from the spliced edit and drop the 16:9 shots and their whooshes.

Safety: a failure, timeout or exception anywhere in the step never blocks the video; it is recorded and the video
finishes without shots. ARMED markers and the creator's `flashback/editor_states/<uuid>.json` are restored on every exit

# Autopilot

Play, stop OBS, close Minecraft. The finished 1080p60 video, the Shorts and `COPY-PASTE.txt` (title options,
description, tags, hashtags, thumbnail prompts) appear in `Finished\<YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM> <title>\`.

Turn it on: UI > Autopilot > switch (or `uv run mcs autopilot enable`). Off by default.

    uv run mcs autopilot run      # foreground loop (the studio UI runs the same loop in a background thread)
    uv run mcs autopilot once     # process what is pending now, then exit  (--no-wait-game, --watch, --output ...)
    uv run mcs autopilot status

Pipeline per recording (one at a time, BELOW_NORMAL priority): project -> transcribe -> analyze -> scaffold ->
autoplan -> **cinematic shots** -> render final -> Shorts -> publish.generate (heuristic, no LLM) -> copy to Finished.
The project is marked "rendered" (Publishing board: Awaiting upload).

Audio tracks: 3+ streams = #2 desktop/game, #3 mic, #1 full mix (ignored); 2 streams = #1 treated as the mix;
1 stream = single mixed track. Mic and game are read from the same file via audio stream indexes.

Rules: originals are never touched; no uploads/network; waits while Minecraft runs or OBS records
(`autopilot.wait_for_game`); a file must be stable 30 s, older than 30 s and readable by ffprobe; recordings shorter
than `min_length_s` and files older than `max_age_h` are ignored; failures are recorded and the loop continues.
State: `studio/autopilot_state.json`; worker logs: `studio/autopilot_logs/`.

## Start at Windows login (optional, not created for you)

Win+R, `shell:startup`, new shortcut with target
`cmd /c "cd /d C:\Users\edmem\OneDrive\Desktop\Minecraft Channel\studio && uv run mcs autopilot run"` (run minimized).
A lock file (PID + heartbeat) keeps only one loop active even if the studio is open too.

## B-roll hook

At plan time, if `mcstudio/cinematic.py` exposes `splice_into_edl(edl, slug)` and `projects/<slug>/broll/shots.json`
exists, that places the shots. Otherwise `autoplan.place_broll` places 2-5 muted 1.5-3 s clips from
`projects/<slug>/broll/*.mp4` (or `Stock Library/Minecraft B-Roll/auto/<session>/`) between segments: an establishing
shot, after loot/death/victory beats, in long calm stretches. No clips = no-op.

## Cinematic shots step  [autopilot-cinematic]

What the creator sees: after the session, **Minecraft opens by itself for a minute or two** (about 90 s for one tiny shot,
2-3 min for two 1080p shots), renders the replay shots and closes again. The Autopilot page says "Rendering cinematic
shots... Minecraft will open for a minute or two: please leave the PC alone" while it runs. Then the video (with the shots)
and the Shorts finish as usual.

Step order inside the worker (`autopilot.cinematic_step`, run record in `work/cinematic_step.json`):

1. `find_replay` (Flashback replay overlapping the recording in wall-clock time) -> none: **skipped, "no replay"**.
2. `plan_shots` on the planned `edit.json` (output time), sync by motion cross-correlation. Sync confidence below
   `cinematic.sync_min_confidence`, or a timestamps-only sync that the video motion did not confirm: **skipped**.
   Nothing is written to `broll/shots.json` for a skipped plan.
3. Wait (up to `autopilot.cinematic_wait_min`, 10) while Minecraft/TLauncher is running or OBS is recording; then give up
   and finish the video without shots. The game is never launched while another one is alive.
4. `queue_jobs` -> `render_queue` with **`FlashbackAutoExporter(launch=True)`** (always the real exporter; the
   `cinematic.exporter` setting is ignored here) -> QA each clip. Watchdog `autopilot.cinematic_timeout_min` (20): on
   timeout the game process tree is killed.
5. `splice` the rendered, QA-passed, real-exporter shots into `edit.json` (backup `edit.v_precinematic.json`), then render
   and Shorts. The Shorts derive from the spliced edit and drop the 16:9 shots and their whooshes.

Safety: a failure, timeout or exception anywhere in the step never blocks the video; it is recorded and the video
finishes without shots. ARMED markers and the creator's `flashback/editor_states/<uuid>.json` are restored on every exit
path (exporter `finally`, plus `_cinematic_cleanup` after any failure). Nothing is written to `.minecraft/mods`.

    def add_clip(path: Path, place: float, src_in: float, dur: float | None, vol: float, label: str, loop=False,
                 natural: float | None = None):
        n = len(inputs)
        inp = (["-stream_loop", "-1"] if loop else []) + ["-ss", f"{src_in:.4f}"]
        if dur:
            inp += ["-t", f"{dur:.4f}"]
        inputs.append(inp + ["-i", path])
        # a sound cut before its natural end fades out instead of stopping dead
        fade = f",afade=t=out:st={max(0.0, dur - 0.14):.3f}:d=0.14" if dur and natural and dur < natural - 0.05 else ""
        chains.append(f"[{n}:a]asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo{fade},"
                      f"volume={db(vol)},adelay=delays={int(place * 1000)}:all=1[{label}]")
        return label

    for i, ev in enumerate(A_.get("sfx", [])):
        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, ctx.warnings, f"sfx[{i}] {ev.get('asset')}")
        if at is None:

        place, src_in, dur = sfx_timing(ctx, ev, at)
        a = ctx.asset(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else {}
        vol = ctx.matched_db(a, ctx.sfx_rel(a), aud["sfx_db"] + (a.get("volume_db") or 0)) + ev.get("volume_db", 0)
        natural = (a.get("tail_s") or a.get("duration_s") or 0) - src_in if a else None
        sfx_bus.append("[" + add_clip(ctx.media_path(ev), place, src_in, dur, vol, f"sfx{i}", natural=natural) + "]")

                 natural: float | None = None):
        n = len(inputs)
        inp = (["-stream_loop", "-1"] if loop else []) + ["-ss", f"{src_in:.4f}"]
        if dur:
            inp += ["-t", f"{dur:.4f}"]
        inputs.append(inp + ["-i", path])
        # a sound cut before its natural end fades out instead of stopping dead
        fade = f",afade=t=out:st={max(0.0, dur - 0.14):.3f}:d=0.14" if dur and natural and dur < natural - 0.05 else ""
        chains.append(f"[{n}:a]asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo{fade},"
                      f"volume={db(vol)},adelay=delays={int(place * 1000)}:all=1[{label}]")
        return label

    for i, ev in enumerate(A_.get("sfx", [])):
        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, ctx.warnings, f"sfx[{i}] {ev.get('asset')}")
        if at is None:
            continue
        place, src_in, dur = sfx_timing(ctx, ev, at)
        a = ctx.asset(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else {}
        vol = ctx.matched_db(a, ctx.sfx_rel(a), aud["sfx_db"] + (a.get("volume_db") or 0)) + ev.get("volume_db", 0)
        natural = (a.get("tail_s") or a.get("duration_s") or 0) - src_in if a else None
        sfx_bus.append("[" + add_clip(ctx.media_path(ev), place, src_in, dur, vol, f"sfx{i}", natural=natural) + "]")

    for j, oa in enumerate(overlay_audio):
        sfx_bus.append("[" + add_clip(oa["path"], oa["at"], oa["in"], oa["dur"], oa["vol"], f"ova{j}",
                                      natural=oa.get("natural")) + "]")

    if sfx_bus and not ctx.S["audio"]["ducking"]:                   # [settings] audio.ducking off: constant level
        pre = "".join(sfx_bus) + (f"amix=inputs={len(sfx_bus)}:normalize=0" if len(sfx_bus) > 1 else "anull")
        chains.append(pre + "[sfxbus]")
        chains.append("[sfxkey]anullsink")
        mix.append("[sfxbus]")
    elif sfx_bus:
        # SFX dip a few dB while you talk, so a sound never buries your words
        d = mxcfg["sfx_duck"]
        pre = "".join(sfx_bus) + (f"amix=inputs={len(sfx_bus)}:normalize=0" if len(sfx_bus) > 1 else "anull")
        chains.append(pre + "[sfxmix]")
        chains.append(f"[sfxmix][sfxkey]sidechaincompress=threshold={d['threshold']}:ratio={d['ratio']}:"
                      f"attack={d['attack']}:release={d['release']}[sfxbus]")
        mix.append("[sfxbus]")
    else:
        chains.append("[sfxkey]anullsink")

    kidx = 0
    for i, m in enumerate(music):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans, ctx.warnings, f"music[{i}]") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        if at is None:
            continue
        until = m.get("until", total)
        dur = max(0.1, until - at)
        a = ctx.asset(m["asset"]) if m.get("asset") else {}
        vol = ctx.matched_db(a, mxcfg["music_rel_db"], aud["music_db"] + (a.get("volume_db") or 0)) \
            + m.get("volume_db", 0)
        n = len(inputs)
        inputs.append(["-stream_loop", "-1", "-ss", f"{m.get('in', 0.0):.3f}", "-i", ctx.media_path(m)])
        fi, fo = m.get("fade_in", 0.5), m.get("fade_out", 1.5)
        c = (f"[{n}:a]asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,atrim=0:{dur:.3f},"
             f"afade=t=in:d={fi},afade=t=out:st={max(0, dur - fo):.3f}:d={fo},volume={db(vol)},"
             f"adelay=delays={int(at * 1000)}:all=1")
        if m.get("duck", True):
            d = aud["duck"]
            chains.append(c + f"[mu{i}]")
            chains.append(f"[mu{i}][key{kidx}]sidechaincompress=threshold={d['threshold']}:ratio={d['ratio']}:"
                          f"attack={d['attack']}:release={d['release']}[mus{i}]")
            kidx += 1
        else:
            chains.append(c + f"[mus{i}]")
        mix.append(f"[mus{i}]")

    chains.append("".join(mix) + f"amix=inputs={len(mix)}:normalize=0:duration=first,"
                  f"atrim=0:{total:.4f},alimiter=limit=0.97:level=false[premix]")
    script = ctx.work / "audio.fc.txt"
    script.write_text(";\n".join(chains), encoding="utf-8")
    premix = ctx.work / "premix.wav"
    flat = [x for inp in inputs for x in inp]
    run_ff([*flat, "-/filter_complex", script, "-map", "[premix]", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", premix], ctx.work, ctx.log)

    # two-pass loudness normalisation to the YouTube target
    I, TP = aud["target_lufs"], aud["true_peak"]

    return AP.api_state()

def autopilot_open_folder(body: dict):
    from . import autopilot as AP
    out_root = Path(AP.load_config()["output_folder"]).resolve()
    p = Path(body.get("path") or out_root).resolve()
    if p != out_root and out_root not in p.parents:
        raise HTTPException(400, "not inside the Finished folder")
    out_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def serve(host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8765, open_browser: bool = True):

    from . import autopilot as AP                       # [autopilot] idles until autopilot.enabled is on
    AP.start_background()
    uvicorn.run(app, host=host, port=port, log_level="warning")

name: feedback-editing-style
description: Creator's editing feedback - SFX under voice, never clip words, memes only their funny part, subtle color polish, many engagement zooms
metadata:
  type: feedback
---
- SFX must sit under the voice, never over it. Levels are voice-relative.
- Never clip the mic: cuts must include each word's full tail. A render cut guard enforces this.
- Memes and SFX: use only the comedic beat, not the full clip. This is not strict; vary it.
- Wants subtle contrast/saturation/vibrance polish on everything (looks presets).
- Wants frequent zoom-ins and snappy edits for short attention spans.
- Wants consistent but not rigid style; extend libraries creatively.

**Why:** stated directly by the creator while reviewing test renders.

**How to apply:** default to these in every edit and when changing the pipeline.
- 2026-10-06 review of the auto edit:
  - Changing the colour grade or mood every few seconds is "very hard to watch". Hold the look steady and change it only for real story sections of 8 s or more.
  - No automatic colour-flash stingers.
  - VFX must fit the moment: no K.O. on a mundane line, no subscribe CTA during a panic.
  - Don't overuse effects. About 14 SFX/min, the same sound at most twice, and zooms mostly on strong beats.
  - SFX must stay clearly under the voice.

The Review page is built and running, and the video is rebuilt with the changes you asked for. The full 1080p render is not done yet: I stopped at a 540p preview so you can review first.

## Review page (training)
Open **http://localhost:8765/#/review/rd-full**. You can also open the studio app, go to Episodes, open rd-full, and click "Review & train this edit". If the page isn't up, run `uv run mcs ui` from the `studio` folder.

- **Preview and timeline:** a preview player sits on top of a full editor timeline with every split clip, zoom, overlay, text, sound effect, music bed and bleep. Clicking a block jumps the preview there and opens its card.
- **A card for every decision:** scenes, drone shots, music, memes, green screens, graphics, text, sound effects and bleeps. Each card shows what you say at that moment and has these buttons:
  - **Keep:** approve the choice.
  - **Swap:** pick from recommended options or search anything in the library.
  - **Edit:** change the text or the graphic's wording.
  - **Remove:** drop it. On a scene this reads "Cut this scene".
  - **Comment:** leave a note on that item.
- **Add something:** "＋ Add something at the current time" lets you drop in a sound, meme, green screen, graphic or text.
- **Apply & re-render preview:** rebuilds the edit with your answers and renders a fresh preview. I tested this end to end.
- **Training:** every answer and comment is saved to `studio/learning`, and the asset finder will favor what you approve and avoid what you reject in future videos. A read-only summary is in `projects/rd-full/REVIEW.md`.
- **Why custom:** HyperFrames' timeline edits its own compositions, not this studio's edits, so I built this into the studio instead.

## What changed in the video
Now 23.0 minutes, one continuous video.

- **Filters:** all removed.
- **Creative mode, commands and menus:** I scanned the full footage for them and cut every stretch where they show. That includes most of the walk across the map, which turned out to be creative flying with the debug screen.
- **Intro:** it now uses your real final take, with the retakes gone.
- **Your voice:** it gets longer endings so words aren't clipped.
- **Montages:** the game audio is muted, with music and block-hit sounds over them.
- **Zooms:** inventory screens are zoomed in.
- **Graphics:** only ones that fit the moment, like the chaos meter, the objective, time skips and the death counter.
- **Opening hook:** it now shows the premise, with random items, the cheat code, blocks landing in every chunk, and chaos level four.
- **Cinematic shots:** 10 real Flashback drone and orbit shots are in. One was rejected for being too dark.

## Not done yet
- The preview you'd see right now is from just before one last fix. The first hook clip now zooms in on the inventory, and pressing Apply re-renders with it.
- **Rage scene:** it still looks like creative mode, so I punch in on it, which was your suggestion. Cut it from the Review page if you'd rather not have it.
- **Sponsor:** I kept the 30-second Cyrus mention. Cut it from the Review page if you want it gone.
- **Music:** I swapped two beds because I guessed which ones you disliked. Tell me which ones were bad and I'll note it.

def _norm(w: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", w.lower())


def find_phrase(words, hint, phrase, within=40.0):
    toks = [_norm(w["word"]) for w in words]
    ph = [_norm(p) for p in phrase]
    best = None
    for i in range(len(words) - len(ph) + 1):
        if abs(words[i]["start"] - hint) > within:
            continue
        if all(toks[i + k] == ph[k] for k in range(len(ph))):
            d = abs(words[i]["start"] - hint)
            if best is None or d < best[0]:
                best = (d, words[i]["start"], words[i + len(ph) - 1]["end"])
    return best[1:] if best else None


def _find_seg(segs, t):
    return next((s for s in segs if s["type"] == "source" and not s["id"].startswith("cold")
                 and s["in"] - 0.01 <= t <= s["out"] + 0.01), None)


def _split(edl, seg, t_split):
    """Split a source segment at source time t_split; events anchored beyond it follow the new tail segment."""
    segs = edl["segments"]
    k = segs.index(seg)
    tail = {kk: v for kk, v in seg.items() if kk not in ("zoom", "shake", "freeze_end")}
    tail["id"] = seg["id"] + "b"
    tail["in"] = round(t_split, 3)
    tail["out"] = seg["out"]
    if seg.get("freeze_end"):
        tail["freeze_end"] = seg["freeze_end"]
    seg["out"] = round(t_split, 3)
    seg.pop("freeze_end", None)
    for key in ("zoom", "shake"):
        if seg.get(key):
            head = [z for z in seg[key] if z.get("src_at", 0) < t_split]
            rest = [z for z in seg[key] if z.get("src_at", 0) >= t_split]
            seg[key] = head
            if rest:
                tail[key] = rest
    segs.insert(k + 1, tail)
    old = seg["id"]
    for lst in (edl["audio"]["sfx"], edl["overlays"], edl["text"], edl["captions"].get("hide", []), edl["audio"]["bleeps"]):
        for ev in lst:
            if ev.get("seg") == old and ev.get("src_at") is not None and ev["src_at"] >= t_split - 1e-6:
                ev["seg"] = tail["id"]
    return tail


def apply_gags(edl: dict, words: list) -> tuple[list, int]:
    miss, n = [], 0
    segs = edl["segments"]
    for kind, part, ts, phrase, asset, ex in GAGS:
        hit = find_phrase(words, T(part, ts), phrase)
        if not hit:
            miss.append((kind, asset, "phrase not found: " + " ".join(phrase)))
            continue
        t0, t1 = hit
        seg = _find_seg(segs, t1)
        if seg is None:
            miss.append((kind, asset, "not in kept footage: " + " ".join(phrase)))
            continue
        a = A.get(asset)
        if kind == "meme":
            if a.get("key_mode") not in (None, "none"):
                miss.append((kind, asset, "is a green screen"))
                continue
            t_split = t1 + 0.28
            if seg["out"] - t_split > 0.9:
                _split(edl, seg, t_split)
            k = segs.index(seg)
            lo = a.get("use_in") or 0.0
            hi = min(a.get("use_out") or a["duration_s"], lo + ex.get("secs", 2.0))
            segs.insert(k + 1, {"id": f"gag-{len(segs)}", "type": "cutaway", "asset": asset, "in": round(lo, 2), "out": round(hi, 2)})
            n += 1
        elif kind == "gs":
            ov = {"type": "greenscreen", "asset": asset, "seg": seg["id"], "src_at": round(t1 + 0.05, 3),
                  "x": ex.get("x", 0.8), "y": ex.get("y", 0.62), "scale": ex.get("scale", 0.5), "dur": ex.get("dur", 1.5)}
            if "src_in" in ex:
                ov["in"] = ex["src_in"]
            edl["overlays"].append(ov)
            n += 1
        elif kind == "icon":
            at = t1 if ex.get("at") == "end" else t0
            edl["overlays"].append({"type": "image", "asset": asset, "seg": seg["id"], "src_at": round(at, 3), "anim": "pop",
                                    "x": ex["x"], "y": ex["y"], "scale": ex["scale"], "dur": ex.get("dur", 1.6)})
            if ex.get("sfx"):
                edl["audio"]["sfx"].append({"asset": ex["sfx"], "seg": seg["id"], "src_at": round(at + 0.02, 3), "align": "onset",
                                            "volume_db": 2 if "fart" in ex["sfx"] else -2})
            n += 1
        elif kind == "sfx":
            edl["audio"]["sfx"].append({"asset": asset, "seg": seg["id"], "src_at": round(t1 + 0.05, 3), "align": "onset",
                                        **({"dur": ex["dur"]} if ex.get("dur") else {})})
    return miss, n

"""Cut short review clips out of rd-full/edit.json and render each as a preview (540p) in its own project.

    uv run python projects/rd-full/make_clips.py 0:00-1:15 1:13-2:22 ...   (output-time ranges of the full edit)
Each clip becomes projects/rd-clip-NN (segments + the events anchored to them + the music that overlaps), rendered to
projects/rd-clip-NN/out/rd-clip-NN_preview.mp4 and copied to projects/rd-full/clips/.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STUDIO = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(STUDIO))
from mcstudio import assets as A  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio.edl import seg_duration  # noqa: E402


def mmss(s: str) -> float:
    m, x = s.split(":")
    return int(m) * 60 + float(x)


def make(n: int, t0: float, t1: float) -> Path:
    edl = json.loads((HERE / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    t = 0.0
    keep, starts = [], {}
    for sg in edl["segments"]:
        d = seg_duration(sg, lambda i: A.get(i))
        if t + d > t0 + 0.01 and t < t1 - 0.01:
            keep.append(sg)
            starts[sg["id"]] = t
        t += d
    if not keep:
        raise SystemExit(f"nothing between {t0} and {t1}")
    base = starts[keep[0]["id"]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in keep}
    out = dict(edl)
    out["segments"] = keep
    out["overlays"] = [o for o in edl["overlays"] if o.get("seg") in ids]
    out["text"] = [x for x in edl["text"] if x.get("seg") in ids]
    out["audio"] = dict(edl["audio"])
    out["audio"]["sfx"] = [e for e in edl["audio"]["sfx"] if e.get("seg") in ids]
    out["audio"]["bleeps"] = [b for b in edl["audio"].get("bleeps", [])
                              if any(s["type"] == "source" and s["in"] - 0.05 <= b["src_at"] <= s["out"] for s in keep)]
    end = base + sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in keep)
    music = []
    for m in edl["audio"].get("music", []):
        a, z = max(m["at"], base), min(m.get("until", end), end)
        if z - a > 1.0:
            music.append({**m, "at": round(a - base, 2), "until": round(z - base, 2),
                          "in": round(m.get("in", 0.0) + (a - m["at"]), 2)})
    out["audio"]["music"] = music
    out["captions"] = dict(edl["captions"])
    out["captions"]["hide"] = [h for h in edl["captions"].get("hide", []) if h.get("seg") in ids]
    out.pop("generator", None)
    slug = f"rd-clip-{n:02d}"
    d = STUDIO / "projects" / slug
    (d / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pj = json.loads((HERE / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj["slug"] = slug
    pj["title"] = f"rd-full clip {n}"
    (d / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(pj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (d / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({**out, "project": slug}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "voice_env.npz"):
        if (HERE / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(HERE / "work" / f, d / "work" / f)
    for sub in ("broll", "overlays"):
        if (HERE / sub).exists():
            dst = d / sub
            if not dst.exists():
                shutil.copytree(HERE / sub, dst)
    print(f"[clip {n}] {t0:.0f}-{t1:.0f}s -> {len(keep)} segments, {end - base:.0f}s", flush=True)
    return d


def main():
    ranges = [(mmss(a.split("-")[0]), mmss(a.split("-")[1])) for a in sys.argv[1:]]
    outdir = HERE / "clips"
    outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for n, (a, b) in enumerate(ranges, 1):
        d = make(n, a, b)
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "mcstudio.cli", "render", d.name, "--preview"], cwd=STUDIO,
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = d / "out" / f"{d.name}_preview.mp4"
        if out.exists():
            shutil.copy2(out, outdir / f"clip{n:02d}.mp4")
            print(f"[clip {n}] rendered -> clips/clip{n:02d}.mp4", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"[clip {n}] FAILED\n{r.stdout[-800:]}\n{r.stderr[-800:]}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    edl = json.loads((HERE / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    t = 0.0
    keep, starts = [], {}
    for sg in edl["segments"]:
        d = seg_duration(sg, lambda i: A.get(i))
        if t + d > t0 + 0.01 and t < t1 - 0.01:
            keep.append(sg)
            starts[sg["id"]] = t
        t += d
    if not keep:
        raise SystemExit(f"nothing between {t0} and {t1}")
    base = starts[keep[0]["id"]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in keep}
    out = dict(edl)
    out["segments"] = keep
    out["overlays"] = [o for o in edl["overlays"] if o.get("seg") in ids]
    out["text"] = [x for x in edl["text"] if x.get("seg") in ids]
    out["audio"] = dict(edl["audio"])
    out["audio"]["sfx"] = [e for e in edl["audio"]["sfx"] if e.get("seg") in ids]
    out["audio"]["bleeps"] = [b for b in edl["audio"].get("bleeps", [])
                              if any(s["type"] == "source" and s["in"] - 0.05 <= b["src_at"] <= s["out"] for s in keep)]
    end = base + sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in keep)
    music = []
    for m in edl["audio"].get("music", []):
        a, z = max(m["at"], base), min(m.get("until", end), end)
        if z - a > 1.0:
            music.append({**m, "at": round(a - base, 2), "until": round(z - base, 2),
                          "in": round(m.get("in", 0.0) + (a - m["at"]), 2)})
    out["audio"]["music"] = music
    out["captions"] = dict(edl["captions"])
    out["captions"]["hide"] = [h for h in edl["captions"].get("hide", []) if h.get("seg") in ids]
    out.pop("generator", None)
    slug = f"rd-clip-{n:02d}"
    d = STUDIO / "projects" / slug
    (d / "work").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pj = json.loads((HERE / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj["slug"] = slug
    pj["title"] = f"rd-full clip {n}"
    (d / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(pj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (d / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps({**out, "project": slug}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "transcript.md", "signals.json", "voice_env.npz"):
        if (HERE / "work" / f).exists():
            shutil.copy2(HERE / "work" / f, d / "work" / f)
    for sub in ("broll", "overlays"):
        if (HERE / sub).exists():
            dst = d / sub
            if not dst.exists():
                shutil.copytree(HERE / sub, dst)
    print(f"[clip {n}] {t0:.0f}-{t1:.0f}s -> {len(keep)} segments, {end - base:.0f}s", flush=True)
    return d


def main():
    ranges = [(mmss(a.split("-")[0]), mmss(a.split("-")[1])) for a in sys.argv[1:]]
    outdir = HERE / "clips"
    outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for n, (a, b) in enumerate(ranges, 1):
        d = make(n, a, b)
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "mcstudio.cli", "render", d.name, "--preview"], cwd=STUDIO,
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = d / "out" / f"{d.name}_preview.mp4"
        if out.exists():
            shutil.copy2(out, outdir / f"clip{n:02d}.mp4")
            print(f"[clip {n}] rendered -> clips/clip{n:02d}.mp4", flush=True)
        else:
            print(f"[clip {n}] FAILED\n{r.stdout[-800:]}\n{r.stderr[-800:]}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import numpy as np, wave, glob
f=sorted(glob.glob('brk/g_2635*.wav'))[0] if glob.glob('brk/g_2635*.wav') else None
print(f)
w=wave.open(f); sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
print(len(x)/sr,'s')
seg=x[int(60*sr):int(120*sr)]
# spectral flux
n=1024; hop=256
win=np.hanning(n)
fr=np.stack([seg[i:i+n]*win for i in range(0,len(seg)-n,hop)])
S=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(fr,axis=1))
freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/sr)
band=(freqs>150)&(freqs<3500)
Sb=np.log1p(S[:,band]*20)
flux=np.maximum(0,np.diff(Sb,axis=0)).sum(1)
t=np.arange(len(flux))*hop/sr
thr=flux.mean()+2.0*flux.std()
pk=[]
last=-1
for i in range(1,len(flux)-1):
    if flux[i]>thr and flux[i]>=flux[i-1] and flux[i]>=flux[i+1] and t[i]-last>0.22:
        pk.append(t[i]); last=t[i]
print(len(pk),[round(p,2) for p in pk[:40]])
loud=np.abs(seg)
print('rms', np.sqrt((seg**2).mean()))
EOF

s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
a = s.index("    env = np.abs(np.diff(x, prepend=0))")
b = s.index("    return on\n", a) + len("    return on\n")
new = '''    # spectral flux in the 150-3500 Hz band: every block break / dig thump is a sudden broadband rise
    n, hop = 1024, 256
    win = np.hanning(n)
    fr = np.stack([x[i:i + n] * win for i in range(0, len(x) - n, hop)])
    S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(fr, axis=1))
    fq = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1 / sr)
    band = (fq > 150) & (fq < 3500)
    flux = np.maximum(0, np.diff(np.log1p(S[:, band] * 20), axis=0)).sum(1)
    t = np.arange(len(flux)) * hop / sr
    thr = flux.mean() + 2.0 * flux.std()
    on, last = [], -9.0
    for i in range(1, len(flux) - 1):
        if flux[i] > thr and flux[i] >= flux[i - 1] and flux[i] >= flux[i + 1] and t[i] - last > 0.25:
            on.append(round(a + float(t[i]), 3))
            last = t[i]
    return on
'''
s = s[:a] + new + s[b:]
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("ok")

I've sent you six short test clips (540p). I haven't rendered the full video yet.

## What each clip shows
1. **Hook + intro (1:14):** a shorter cold open, then your final take of the intro with the item icons. Stone turns into a diamond, a diamond turns into dirt, and the fart sound plays on "dirt."
2. **Inventory, chest, boat, spider (1:21):** the "we need a chest" line plays in full.
3. **Cheat code + grass montage (1:00).**
4. **The diamond-duplication fail (2:12).**
5. **Go ham + chaos level four (51 s).**
6. **TNT ending + "I give up" (1:34).**

## What changed in this pass
- **Cold open:** trimmed to about 33 seconds, with the "diamond blocks everywhere" clip ending early.
- **Intro:**
  - I found the exact moment your final take starts, so the first word isn't clipped.
  - No title card, time card or any motion graphic before or during the intro.
  - The part 2 recap lines that mentioned a "last video" are gone.
- **Chest line:** I cut the time card that was landing on it, and the whole sentence now plays.
- **Motion graphics:** I removed all the time cards, wipes and chapter signs. What's left are small fitting touches such as the stronghold toast, the dragon-death counter and the item icons.
- **Block-breaking montages**, rebuilt:
  - They use only moments where a block really breaks, detected from the game audio.
  - Each fragment is the same length and keeps the game's own break sound, so the sounds line up with the breaks and the rhythm repeats.
  - Your voice is muted there, and the music is turned up.
  - Montages in footage too dark to see are dropped. That removed the first block-breaking montage and the "speed through" one.
- **Memes and funny edits:**
  - 29 memes, green screens and item-icon pops, each placed right after the line it goes with. That's about 1.25 per minute.
  - A gap filler adds a quick zoom and sound if anything goes longer than about 22 seconds without an edit.
- **Audio balance:** the game sits under your voice while you talk, and music is louder in the montages.

## Things to check in the clips
- The first block-breaking montage and the "speed through" one are gone, because that footage is too dark to see. If you want something there instead, tell me what.
- I haven't heard the clips myself. I measured loudness (about -15 LUFS in the montage clip) but couldn't judge whether the music suits the tone. Tell me which clips or music feel off and I'll swap the beds.
- The stretches that look boring or random to you will be easiest to flag on the Review page. Tell me which clips feel flat and I'll tighten those scenes.

    out = []

                break

    ex = w["opts"]

    sm = ex.get("speedmix")

    if not sm:
